Ported bounded NumberInput controls for Merge gap (0-1000 ms) and Merge repeat (1-64), preserving Cancel without mutation and applying values only on Confirm. A 0 ms gap adds no artificial separator; non-zero gaps remain safely chunked. Hardware acceptance covered NumberInput, Cancel/Confirm, zero and non-zero merge gaps, save, reopen, and playback of the user's own RAW signal.
